statement: Samsung's SF4 production line in Pyeongtaek operates at full capacity producing logic chips for clients including Qualcomm and base dies for Samsung's own HBM, and Samsung cannot meet all orders.
why: A fully loaded leading-edge line that must ration between external customers and internal HBM base dies is a hard supply ceiling sitting directly under the memory that accelerators need.

impact.mechanism: Full utilization on the SF4 line forces allocation between external logic customers and internal HBM base-die production, capping incremental supply of both.

evidence.excerpt: Samsung's SF4 production line in Pyeongtaek, South Korea operates at full capacity, producing logic chips for clients including Qualcomm and base dies for Samsung's own HBM chips.

confidence.basis: Reuters wire reporting relayed by a single outlet; secondary-only evidence.
